About this page

The phone-book of the Eduversal leadership graph — Executive Directors, Directors, Consultants, and Coordinators across the network.

Each card is a mini business card: name, role(s), subject, contact details, academic qualifications, and previous institutions. The Subject Leaders shown on every Department Workspace canvas are pulled from this same list.

  • Find someone fast — search by name, position, email, institution, or degree; or filter by subject, school, and status.
  • Add a new entry — click + New entry, pick the entry kind, and fill in their role(s), subject(s), and contact details.
  • Record their background — capture each person's academic qualifications (degrees) and the institutions they worked or studied at before joining.
  • Keep it current — edit any card to update details, or archive entries for people who have left.
How to use →

New entry

Add one or more roles. Press Enter or , to add. e.g. Director of Secondary Education · Math Coordinator · EASE Lead G7-G12.
Click to toggle. Leave all unselected for cross-subject roles.
Open string. Today's usage: EASE per-grade committees from the meeting corpus.
Where this person worked or studied before. Press Enter or , to add. e.g. British School Jakarta · University of Cambridge.
Degree, field of study, awarding institution, and year. e.g. M.Ed. · Mathematics Education · University of Melbourne · 2018.
Pick a CH / AH / TH user if this person already has an account. Skip if they haven't onboarded yet.
Coordinators Workspace · Directory

Know who to call before you need them.

Subject coordinators across the network sit one click away. Reach out to a peer in another subject before raising a cross-cutting decision — agreement upstream saves rework downstream.
